sentence: Direct tests are beginning just outside the corpus: on 570 Spanish manufacturing firms, Vaillant et al. find that AI platforms raise cooperative and capability-building behavior along the solution delivery process [CITE], and that this cooperation builds the grounding, bounding and recasting capabilities the theory names, in what the authors call one of the first empirical applications of situated AI
passage: [Vaillant et al. (2025), sec. 6.1] "It was found that such usage does indeed facilitate cooperation during the problem identification and solution implementation stages, and, as predicted by the theory of situated AI, this cooperation leads solution ecosystems towards greater AI-driven situating capabilities, namely, those attained through grounding, bounding, and recasting." / [sec. 6.2] "this is one of the first studies to empirically apply the situated AI theory."

gemini.note: The passage supports the claims about cooperation, situated capabilities, and being an early empirical application, but it does not contain the demographic information about 570 Spanish manufacturing firms.
